defense_news.title: F-47 program producing test aircraft,  on schedule for 2028 flight
defense_news.summary: The F-47 program has begun its engineering and manufacturing phase and will fly during this presidential administration, a service official said.

defense_news.title: Navy awards $76.6 billion for Virginia, Columbia-class submarines
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Navy is spending $76.6 billion to build five Columbia-class and nine Virginia-class submarines.

defense_news.title: Iran war depleted US Patriot missile stockpiles, creating readiness challenges, experts say
defense_news.summary: The U.S. has depleted roughly two-thirds of its pre-war Patriot missile interceptor inventory during the conflict with Iran, new analysis says.

defense_news.title: Iran to get Chinese shoulder-launched missile systems in weeks, sources say
defense_news.summary: Iran is expected to receive within weeks a first shipment out of up to 400 Chinese-made shoulder-fired air defense missile launchers.
